insights.body: App Total Install was 22,114, against 24,479 for the average of the same weekday over the past 4 weeks — a change of -2,365. Where that came from: Organic Install -1,145 (-10.3%), Paid Install -670 (-5.9%), SEO Install -520 (-34.1%). Organic Install moved the most on its own (-1,145, -10.3%) and is now 45.1% of all installs, so that is the channel to look at first. Known event: YCP iOS was delisted from the App Store on 2026-10-21 (因下架); its iOS Install / New User collapse is expected and its Install→New Subs conversion is an artefact. YCP accounts for about 100% of this change (-2,560).

insights.title: Purchase type by country — Subscription revenue is falling most in JP (-44.6%), while BR grows (+41.5%).
insights.body: By country: the biggest Subscription fall is JP -1,621 (-44.6%, about 5% of revenue); the biggest Subscription gain is BR +1,286 (+41.5%); Pay as you go moved most in JP +705 (+47.0%); JP relies most on Pay as you go (52% of its revenue vs 6.6% overall). Subscription is the recurring revenue that new subs feed; Pay as you go is one-off spend.

insights.title: Revenue vs new subs — App Total Revenue +2.7% does not match new subs -16.8% from 7 days earlier — this growth is not coming from new customers.
insights.body: App Total Revenue on 11-16 vs 11-09 is +2.7%, but App Total New Subs on 11-09 vs 11-02 was -16.8% — they did not move together. Most new subs start as a 7-day free trial, so the subscription revenue landing now mostly comes from people who subscribed about 7 days ago. By purchase type (on 11-16 vs 11-09): Subscription +1.0%, Pay as you go +34.2%. Since new subs moved the other way while Subscription revenue (+1.0%) did not follow them, this growth is coming from existing customers instead: check renewals and cancellations, refunds, or a recent price change — not marketing or installs.

insights.title: Which country — BR is out of line with every other country on App Total Revenue (+40.5% vs +1.4%).
insights.body: For All App, App Total Revenue in BR is +40.5% while all countries together are +1.4% — a gap of +39.1pp. BR is about 5% of revenue, so it is big enough to be worth a look.

insights.title: Best and worst markets — GB turns installs into new subs best of anywhere (21.0% vs 11.2% overall).
insights.body: In GB, 21.0% of installs turn into new subs, versus 11.2% across all markets and apps (+9.8pp difference). That is much better than the rest — worth understanding and copying. GB is about 3% of revenue. Its App Total New Subs is -16.2% this period.

insights.title: Which app — App Total New User -12.8% is mostly YCP — not every app (因下架).
insights.body: App Total New User moved -12.8% overall, but the apps are far apart (All App -12.8%, YMK -0.4%, YCP -82.9%, YCV -12.4%). YCP accounts for most of it, so look at what changed in that one app rather than something affecting all of them.
